name: Touch of Death
body:
You can channel your ki to disrupt the flow of life force through a target’s body.

Prerequisite(s): Ki class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +5, assassin level 1st.

Benefit(s): When using the death attack ability with an unarmed strike, you can expend ki to increase the DC. Every point of ki spent increases the DC by 1. You can spend a maximum number of points equal to half your assassin level.
